expected_pass_rate: >= 0.85 (17 test cases in all; the main metric is task_success, scored 0 or 1 for the whole task: it is 1 only if no blocking failure occurs and every functional case passes — the registered process and performance cases are excluded from the functional set but block on failure; the pass-rate threshold on the left and the per-case pass rate are recorded as diagnostics only)
constraints: No lookup table of any kind may be used (including a hard-coded S-box array) — a pure bitwise implementation
if/else branches are not allowed (branchless); selection must be done by bit operations
The affine transformation: b'i = bi XOR b(i+4)mod8 XOR b(i+5)mod8 XOR b(i+6)mod8 XOR b(i+7)mod8 XOR ci, c=0x63
Inversion in GF(2^8) may use Fermat's little theorem inv(x)=x^254 mod p(x), the extended Euclidean algorithm, or a tower field decomposition
The input range is 0-255 and the output 0-255; anything outside raises ValueError
source: FIPS PUB 197 §5.1.1 S-box; Canright CHES 2005 (tower field); 《密码工程》(Cryptographic Engineering, in Chinese) Ch.8 §4
author: Liang Jing
